{"metadata":{"description":"Multimodal bridge for any LLM: qwen_vision (Qwen-VL) + qwen_generate (Qwen-Image) — an MCP server for Kimi Code & Claude Code, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin (dsh-multimodal-bridge). 给任何 LLM 补上 Qwen 视觉与出图能力：MCP server（Kimi Code / Claude Code）+ DeepSeek Harness 插件双形态。","id":"gh:1291220133","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"multimodal-bridge","slug":"Spirit4471/multimodal-bridge","topics":["deepseek","dsh-plugin","kimi-k3","llm","mcp","qwen"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Multimodal bridge for any LLM: qwen_vision (Qwen-VL) + qwen_generate (Qwen-Image) — an MCP server fo"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"r Kimi Code & Claude Code, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin (dsh-multimodal-bridge). 给任何 LLM 补上 Qwen 视觉"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"与出图能力：MCP server（Kimi Code / Claude Code）+ DeepSeek Harness 插件双形态。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# multimodal-bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**多模态 MCP 桥** — 给纯文本 LLM 补上视觉理解与图像生成能力，或给多模态模型补上它没有的图像生成能力。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## v2.0：双轨工作流"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Harness engineering 的第一原则：**让模型用它原生的能力干活，桥只补模型真正缺的那一块**。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| 能力 | 主线：Kimi Code + K3 | 备选线：Claude Code + DeepSeek |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| **Coding harness** | Kimi Code CLI | Claude Code |
